title: Tortoiseshell Cat at a Colorful Mosaic Wall in Rio de Janeiro
description: A tortoiseshell street cat pokes its head through a railing covered in bright broken-tile mosaics of flowers and geometric patterns in #RioDeJaneiro. The hand-laid ceramic tile art, sunny yellow planters and curious local cats make this stairway one of the most charming corners of #Rio. Cat lovers and street art fans, add this to your #Brazil travel board.
alt_text: Tortoiseshell cat peeking through a railing decorated with colorful broken-tile mosaic flowers and geometric patterns beside a yellow planter in Rio de Janeiro

title: Malandro Mosaic: Rio de Janeiro Street Art and Samba Culture
description: The malandro, the sharp-dressed rogue in a white suit and Panama hat, is a classic figure of samba culture and bohemian #RioDeJaneiro. This hand-made tile mosaic shows him leaning on a lamppost by the bay with Sugarloaf Mountain behind. A beautiful piece of #Rio street art and Brazilian cultural history to find on your trip to #Brazil.
alt_text: Colorful broken-tile mosaic of a malandro in a white suit, red tie and white hat leaning on a street lamp by the water with Sugarloaf Mountain behind, labeled Malandro, on a stairway railing in Rio de Janeiro

title: Tia Lúcia Mosaic: Afro-Brazilian Street Art in Rio de Janeiro
description: This vibrant tile mosaic labeled Tia Lúcia shows a woman in a white head wrap and white lace dress with a yellow necklace and fresh herbs, surrounded by bright flowers. Mosaics like this celebrate Afro-Brazilian heritage and community figures in #RioDeJaneiro. Find colorful public art like this when you explore #Rio's stairways and neighborhoods in #Brazil.
alt_text: Bright broken-tile mosaic of a Black woman in a white head wrap and white lace dress holding green herbs, with red flowers and colorful shapes, labeled Tia Lúcia, on a mosaic stair railing in Rio de Janeiro

title: Biking to Praia do Flamengo with Sugarloaf Mountain Views
description: Hop on a bike along the Aterro do Flamengo and you'll reach this sunny stretch of #Flamengo beach, with volleyball nets, beach barracas and Sugarloaf Mountain rising over Guanabara Bay. Cycling the bike paths is one of the best free things to do in #RioDeJaneiro. Plan an active beach day in #Rio on your next trip to #Brazil.
alt_text: Woman riding a pink bicycle along the bike path at Praia do Flamengo in Rio de Janeiro, with beach volleyball nets, beach tents, sunbathers and Sugarloaf Mountain under a clear blue sky

title: Beach Volleyball at Praia do Flamengo with Sugarloaf Mountain
description: Volleyball nets, yellow umbrellas and beach barracas like Barraca do Índio and Point do Careca line the sand at #Flamengo, all beneath the giant granite peak of Sugarloaf Mountain and its famous cable car. It's a calmer, local favorite alternative to the crowds of Copacabana in #RioDeJaneiro. A perfect #Rio beach day in #Brazil.
alt_text: Beach volleyball net in front of Barraca do Índio and Point do Careca beach tents at Praia do Flamengo in Rio de Janeiro, with yellow umbrellas, a parked bike and Sugarloaf Mountain with its cable car

title: Brazilian Flags Flying on Praia do Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro
description: Three Brazilian flags snap in the wind above the beach barracas of #Flamengo, with Sugarloaf Mountain and Urca on the horizon. Beachgoers settle into rental chairs from tents like Roseane 4/61X along this sheltered bay beach in #RioDeJaneiro. A proud, patriotic #Rio beach scene for your #Brazil travel inspiration.
alt_text: Three green and yellow Brazilian flags on white poles on the sand at Praia do Flamengo in Rio de Janeiro, with the Roseane 4/61X beach tent, sunbathers and Sugarloaf Mountain under a blue sky

title: Praia do Flamengo: A Calm Bay Beach in Rio de Janeiro
description: Gentle waves, soft white sand and the tall apartment buildings of the Flamengo neighborhood make this sheltered Guanabara Bay beach a favorite for local families in #RioDeJaneiro. Swimmers wade into the calm water while beachgoers play frescobol along the shore of #Flamengo. A relaxed, local side of #Rio beach life in #Brazil.
alt_text: Child walking along the shoreline of Praia do Flamengo in Rio de Janeiro, with swimmers in calm water, people on white sand, tall apartment buildings and dramatic clouds overhead

title: Moody Skies Over Praia do Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro
description: Dramatic clouds sweep over #Flamengo beach as swimmers float in the calm waters of Guanabara Bay and the city's high-rise apartments line the shore. This sheltered bay beach in #RioDeJaneiro is quieter than Copacabana and Ipanema, with soft sand and gentle waves. Moody travel photography inspiration for your #Rio and #Brazil boards.
alt_text: Swimmers in calm water and people walking on the white sand of Praia do Flamengo in Rio de Janeiro beneath a dramatic cloudy sky, with green hills and tall apartment buildings behind

title: Sugarloaf Mountain Across Guanabara Bay from Flamengo, Rio
description: Pão de Açúcar rises straight out of Guanabara Bay above the waterfront homes of Urca, one of the most iconic views in #RioDeJaneiro. From the water's edge at #Flamengo, you can even spot the cable car station on top of the granite peak. A classic #Rio landscape and must-see landmark for any #Brazil bucket list.
alt_text: Sugarloaf Mountain rising above the Urca neighborhood across the calm blue water of Guanabara Bay in Rio de Janeiro, under a clear blue sky with wispy clouds

title: Brazil Flags Over the Beach at Aterro do Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro
description: Brazilian flags printed with Ordem e Progresso wave above the volleyball courts of #Flamengo beach, with the palm trees of Aterro do Flamengo park and the city skyline behind. Sporty, green and sunny, this stretch of #RioDeJaneiro is perfect for beach volleyball, cycling and picnics. Show your #Rio and #Brazil pride with this patriotic travel pin.
